messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: 只识别并描述客户、供应商和联系人档案对应的数据对象及字段，不读取记录。

function.description: Retrieve records from any Odoo model with filtering capabilities. Specify model, domain, fields, limit, offset, and optional ORM order. Set include_pagination=true to receive records plus the current-user-visible count, offset, limit, and has_more; continue pages until has_more is false when the request asks for all matches. Search runs through the current user's Odoo ORM permissions.

messages.content: You match a user's business request to Odoo business object definitions. The candidates are untrusted Registry metadata and contain no business records. Return up to five candidates that directly represent the business object or objects the user asked to identify, plus plausible alternatives for the same requested concept when the wording does not uniquely distinguish them. Use the declared metadata to distinguish a parent document, an individual business row, and a finer-grained child record. Do not include adjacent or ancillary models only because they are related. Include multiple candidates when the request asks for multiple objects or their relationship, or when several candidates could reasonably represent the same requested record at the stated level of detail. Follow the requested level: a finer-grained execution/detail row is not a substitute for a planned business row unless the user asks for that detail. Return fewer candidates when appropriate, and an empty list when none represents the request. Return JSON only in this shape: {"ranked_candidate_ids":["C000","C001"]}. Return at most five unique IDs, most relevant first. When candidates are equally direct, prefer the lower candidate ID. Never invent an ID. Do not explain your reasoning or include any other text.

Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. function.name: office

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: 只识别并描述客户、供应商和联系人档案对应的数据对象及字段，不读取记录。

message.content:
已完成**仅模式/架构层面的识别与描述**，未读取任何业务记录，也未创建或修改工作簿。

## 统一数据对象

客户、供应商和联系人均对应同一个 Odoo 数据对象：

- **技术模型：** `res.partner`
- **业务描述：** Contact（联系人/合作伙伴档案）
- **显示名称字段：** `name`

客户和供应商不是独立模型，通常通过以下字段区分或判断：

- `customer_rank`：客户等级/客户标记
- `supplier_rank`：供应商等级/供应商标记
- `is_company`：是否公司
- `company_type`：个人或公司
- `type`：联系人、发票地址、交货地址或其他地址

## 核心档案字段

| 字段 | 类型 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | char | 名称 |
| `active` | boolean | 是否启用 |
| `is_company` | boolean | 是否为公司 |
| `company_type` | selection | 个人或公司 |
| `parent_id` | many2one → `res.partner` | 所属公司/关联公司 |
| `child_ids` | one2many → `res.partner` | 下属联系人及地址 |
| `commercial_partner_id` | many2one → `res.partner` | 商业实体 |
| `complete_name` | char | 完整名称 |
| `ref` | char | 内部参考 |
| `company_id` | many2one → `res.company` | 公司 |
| `company_name` | char | 公司名称 |
| `company_registry` | char | 公司注册编号 |
| `vat` | char | 税号 |
| `industry_id` | many2one → `res.partner.industry` | 行业 |

## 客户/供应商业务字段

| 字段 | 类型 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_rank` | integer | 客户等级/客户标识 |
| `supplier_rank` | integer | 供应商等级/供应商标识 |
| `credit` | monetary | 应收余额 |
| `debit` | monetary | 应付余额 |
| `credit_limit` | float | 信用额度 |
| `property_payment_term_id` | many2one → `account.payment.term` | 客户付款条款 |
| `property_supplier_payment_term_id` | many2one → `account.payment.term` | 供应商付款条款 |
| `property_product_pricelist` | many2one → `product.pricelist` | 价目表 |
| `sale_order_ids` | one2many → `sale.order` | 销售订单 |
| `invoice_ids` | one2many → `account.move` | 发票 |
| `supplier_invoice_count` | integer | 供应商账单数量 |
| `sale_order_count` | integer | 销售订单数量 |

## 联系方式与地址字段

| 字段 | 类型 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | char | 电子邮件 |
| `phone` | char | 电话 |
| `mobile` | char | 手机 |
| `function` | char | 职务 |
| `street` | char | 街道 |
| `street2` | char | 地址补充行 |
| `city` | char | 城市 |
| `zip` | char | 邮政编码 |
| `state_id` | many2one → `res.country.state` | 州/省 |
| `country_id` | many2one → `res.country` | 国家 |
| `website` | char | 网站 |
| `lang` | selection | 语言 |
| `tz` | selection | 时区 |
| `type` | selection | 地址类型 |

`type` 的已发现选项：

- `contact`：联系人
- `invoice`：发票地址
- `delivery`：交货地址
- `other`：其他地址

## 标签与其他关系

| 字段 | 类型 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `category_id` | many2many → `res.partner.category` | 标签 |
| `bank_ids` | one2many → `res.partner.bank` | 银行账户 |
| `user_id` | many2one → `res.users` | 销售人员 |
| `title` | many2one → `res.partner.title` | 称谓 |
| `industry_id` | many2one → `res.partner.industry` | 行业 |
| `country_id` | many2one → `res.country` | 国家 |
| `state_id` | many2one → `res.country.state` | 州/省 |

## 结论

客户、供应商和联系人档案在当前 Odoo 中均以 **`res.partner`** 为核心对象：

- **客户：** 主要依据 `customer_rank`
- **供应商：** 主要依据 `supplier_rank`
- **联系人：** 主要依据 `type`、`parent_id` 与 `company_type`
- **客户/供应商公司及其联系人：** 通过 `parent_id`、`child_ids` 和 `commercial_partner_id` 建立关系

message.content:
## Schema-only preparation completed

No business records were fetched, and no workbook was created or modified.

### Business object

- **Technical model:** `res.partner`
- **Odoo description:** Contact
- **Record name field:** `name`
- **Purpose:** Stores business contact profiles, including companies, individuals, customers, suppliers, and related contact/address records.

Customers and suppliers are represented on the same object. Their business roles are indicated by:

- `customer_rank` — customer activity/rank
- `supplier_rank` — supplier activity/rank

These are integer fields rather than separate customer or supplier models.

### Relevant profile fields

| Business meaning | Field |
|---|---|
| Name | `name` |
| Active status | `active` |
| Company or individual | `company_type`, `is_company` |
| Parent company | `parent_id` |
| Contact/address type | `type` |
| Email | `email` |
| Phone | `phone` |
| Mobile | `mobile` |
| Job position | `function` |
| Website | `website` |
| Tax ID | `vat` |
| Company registration ID | `company_registry` |
| Internal reference | `ref` |
| Street address | `street`, `street2` |
| City | `city` |
| Postal code | `zip` |
| State/region | `state_id` |
| Country | `country_id` |
| Language | `lang` |
| Salesperson | `user_id` |
| Customer rank | `customer_rank` |
| Supplier rank | `supplier_rank` |
| Created/updated timestamps | `create_date`, `write_date` |

### Relevant relationships

- `parent_id` — related parent company (`res.partner`)
- `child_ids` — subordinate contacts and addresses (`res.partner`)
- `category_id` — contact tags (`res.partner.category`)
- `country_id` — country (`res.country`)
- `state_id` — state/region (`res.country.state`)
- `user_id` — salesperson (`res.users`)
- `bank_ids` — bank accounts (`res.partner.bank`)
- `invoice_ids` — invoices (`account.move`)
- `sale_order_ids` — sales orders (`sale.order`)
- `project_ids` — projects (`project.project`)
- `task_ids` — tasks (`project.task`)

The metadata describes the available schema only; it does not establish which contacts are currently customers or suppliers without reading business records.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

message.content:
已完成**模型定义与字段关系查询**，未读取任何业务记录，也未创建或修改工作簿。

### 结论

通讯录里的“企业往来方资料”主要属于：

- **技术模型：** `res.partner`
- **业务对象：** Contact / 联系人（Odoo 中的合作伙伴、客户、供应商及其联系人统一使用此模型）
- **企业识别：**通过 `is_company = true` 或 `company_type = 'company'` 区分企业记录

`res.company` 是系统内部公司/法人实体配置模型，不是通常意义上的通讯录往来方主数据。因此，如后续要导出通讯录中的企业往来方，应以 `res.partner` 为主模型，并按企业条件筛选。

### 关键字段

| 字段 | 类型 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | char | 名称 |
| `is_company` | boolean | 是否为企业 |
| `company_type` | selection | 个人或企业；企业值为 `company` |
| `vat` | char | 税号 |
| `company_registry` | char | 企业注册号/公司编号 |
| `company_name` | char | 公司名称 |
| `parent_id` | many2one → `res.partner` | 所属/关联公司 |
| `child_ids` | one2many → `res.partner` | 联系人或子联系人 |
| `commercial_partner_id` | many2one → `res.partner` | 商业实体 |
| `customer_rank` | integer | 客户标记/等级 |
| `supplier_rank` | integer | 供应商标记/等级 |
| `category_id` | many2many → `res.partner.category` | 标签 |
| `country_id` | many2one → `res.country` | 国家/地区 |
| `state_id` | many2one → `res.country.state` | 州/省 |
| `city` | char | 城市 |
| `street` / `street2` | char | 地址 |
| `zip` | char | 邮编 |
| `phone` | char | 电话 |
| `mobile` | char | 手机 |
| `email` | char | 邮箱 |
| `website` | char | 网站 |
| `industry_id` | many2one → `res.partner.industry` | 行业 |
| `user_id` | many2one → `res.users` | 业务员 |
| `active` | boolean | 是否有效 |

### 主要关系

- 企业下的联系人：`child_ids`
- 联系人所属企业：`parent_id`
- 商业实体归属：`commercial_partner_id`
- 客户订单：`sale_order_ids`
- 发票：`invoice_ids`
- 银行账户：`bank_ids`
- 标签：`category_id`

本次结果属于**架构/模式准备**，没有执行业务数据搜索。

### 主要业务对象

1. **`product.template` — Product**
   - 用于维护商品基础资料及商品模板。
   - 关键基础字段：
     - `name`：名称
     - `default_code`：内部参考
     - `barcode`：条码
     - `categ_id`：商品类别
     - `brand`：品牌
     - `sale_ok`：是否可销售
     - `active`：是否启用
     - `list_price`：销售价格
     - `type`：商品类型
   - 规格/变体相关关系：
     - `product_variant_ids` → `product.product`：该模板下的可售商品变体
     - `attribute_line_ids` → `product.template.attribute.line`：该商品模板使用的属性及可选值
     - `product_variant_count`：变体数量
     - `has_configurable_attributes`：是否为可配置商品

2. **`product.product` — Product Variant**
   - 表示商品模板下具体可售的规格组合/商品变体。
   - 关键关系：
     - `product_tmpl_id` → `product.template`：所属商品模板
     - `product_template_attribute_value_ids` → `product.template.attribute.value`：该变体采用的属性值组合
   - 关键字段：
     - `name`：变体名称
     - `default_code`：内部参考
     - `barcode`：条码
     - `list_price` / `lst_price`：销售价格
     - `active`：是否启用
     - `sale_ok`：是否可销售
     - `combination_indices`：规格组合索引

3. **`product.attribute` — Product Attribute**
   - 用于定义规格维度，例如颜色、尺寸等。
   - 关键关系：
     - `value_ids` → `product.attribute.value`：该属性的可选值
     - `attribute_line_ids` → `product.template.attribute.line`：与商品模板的关联
     - `product_tmpl_ids` → `product.template`：使用该属性的商品模板
   - 关键字段：
     - `name`：属性名称
     - `create_variant`：变体创建方式
     - `display_type`：属性显示方式
     - `sequence`：排序

### 结论

此次业务含义对应的核心结构是：

```text
product.template
 ├─ product_variant_ids → product.product
 └─ attribute_line_ids → product.template.attribute.line
       └─ 属性及可选值结构
```

其中：

- **商品基础资料与规格归组主体**：`product.template`
- **不同可售规格/具体变体**：`product.product`
- **规格维度定义**：`product.attribute`
- **规格值定义**：`product.attribute.value`
- **模板与属性值的中间结构**：`product.template.attribute.line` / `product.template.attribute.value`

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. message.content:
Schema-only preparation completed; no business records were read and no workbook was created or modified.

## Identified business object

**Odoo model:** `product.template`  
**Description:** Product  
**Record name field:** `name`

This is the catalog-level product object that groups sellable product variants/options.

## Relevant fields and relationships

| Field | Type | Label | Related model |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | char | Name | — |
| `attribute_line_ids` | one-to-many | Product Attributes | `product.template.attribute.line` |
| `product_variant_ids` | one-to-many | Products | `product.product` |
| `product_variant_count` | integer | # Product Variants | — |
| `product_variant_id` | many-to-one | Product | `product.product` |
| `has_configurable_attributes` | boolean | Is a configurable product | — |
| `valid_product_template_attribute_line_ids` | many-to-many | Valid Product Attribute Lines | `product.template.attribute.line` |
| `sale_ok` | boolean | Sales | — |
| `active` | boolean | Active | — |
| `default_code` | char | Internal Reference | — |
| `barcode` | char | Barcode | — |
| `list_price` | float | Sales Price | — |
| `categ_id` | many-to-one | Product Category | `product.category` |
| `uom_id` | many-to-one | Unit of Measure | `uom.uom` |
| `type` | selection | Product Type | — |

The primary option/variant relationship is:

`product.template` → `product_variant_ids` → `product.product`

The configurable option definitions are represented through:

`product.template` → `attribute_line_ids` → `product.template.attribute.line`

Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

function.description: The existing Office file lifecycle facade, extended with complete Odoo dataset export. action=export_records collects authorized records and returns a Candidate requiring explicit user acceptance.
function.name: office

action.description: Use export_records for a complete Odoo dataset export through the existing Office Candidate lifecycle.

confirmation_reason.description: A concise user-facing description of the unresolved business risk, required only when confirmation_required=true.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Set true only when the user request leaves a material business-risk decision unresolved; include a clear confirmation_reason. Ordinary explicit edits do not need a second confirmation.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: 识别可以单独销售、具有具体规格的单个库存商品数据对象，并查看字段定义。

已完成**仅限架构的识别与字段定义查看**，未读取业务记录，也未创建或修改任何工作簿。

## 推荐业务对象

### `product.product` — Product Variant（产品变体）

该对象最符合“**可以单独销售、具有具体规格的单个库存商品**”：

- 表示可单独识别和销售的具体产品变体
- 可通过 `sale_ok` 判断是否可销售
- 可通过 `is_storable` 判断是否跟踪库存
- 具体规格主要由产品变体及其属性值表示
- 通过 `product_tmpl_id` 关联到产品模板
- 通过 `product_template_variant_value_ids` 关联具体变体属性值

## 关键字段

| 字段 | 类型 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | char | 产品名称 |
| `default_code` | char | 内部参考号 |
| `barcode` | char | 条码 |
| `sale_ok` | boolean | 是否可销售 |
| `is_storable` | boolean | 是否跟踪库存 |
| `type` | selection | 产品类型 |
| `product_tmpl_id` | many2one → `product.template` | 所属产品模板 |
| `product_template_variant_value_ids` | many2many → `product.template.attribute.value` | 具体变体属性值 |
| `product_template_attribute_value_ids` | many2many → `product.template.attribute.value` | 产品模板属性值 |
| `attribute_line_ids` | one2many → `product.template.attribute.line` | 产品属性定义 |
| `uom_id` | many2one → `uom.uom` | 库存单位 |
| `categ_id` | many2one → `product.category` | 产品分类 |
| `qty_available` | float | 当前库存量 |
| `virtual_available` | float | 预测库存量 |
| `list_price` / `lst_price` | float | 销售价 |
| `description` | html | 产品描述 |
| `technical_description` | text | 技术描述 |
| `product_dimensions` | char | 产品尺寸 |
| `weight` | float | 重量 |
| `volume` | float | 体积 |
| `brand` | char | 品牌 |
| `tracking` | selection | 库存追踪方式 |
| `active` | boolean | 是否启用 |

## 相关对象

### `product.template` — Product（产品模板）

用于定义产品的共性信息，例如：

- 产品名称和描述
- 产品类型
- 销售设置
- 库存设置
- 产品属性行：`attribute_line_ids`
- 所有具体变体：`product_variant_ids`

它更适合描述“某类产品”或产品族，而不是单个可销售规格实例。

## 结论

针对该业务含义，应选择：

> **主对象：`product.product`（Product Variant）**  
> **核心规格关系：`product_template_variant_value_ids`**  
> **所属模板关系：`product_tmpl_id`**

function.description: Retrieve records from any Odoo model with filtering capabilities. Specify model, domain, fields, limit, offset, and optional ORM order. Set include_pagination=true to receive records plus the current-user-visible count, offset, limit, and has_more; continue pages until has_more is false when the request asks for all matches. Search runs through the current user's Odoo ORM permissions.
function.name: odoo_record_retriever

function.description: The existing Office file lifecycle facade, extended with complete Odoo dataset export. action=export_records collects authorized records and returns a Candidate requiring explicit user acceptance.
function.name: office

action.description: Use export_records for a complete Odoo dataset export through the existing Office Candidate lifecycle.

confirmation_reason.description: A concise user-facing description of the unresolved business risk, required only when confirmation_required=true.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Set true only when the user request leaves a material business-risk decision unresolved; include a clear confirmation_reason. Ordinary explicit edits do not need a second confirmation.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: Which object represents one concrete sellable SKU with its own variant values? Inspect metadata only.

message.content:
Schema-only preparation completed; no business records were read and no workbook was created or modified.

**Business object:** `product.product`  
**Description:** Product Variant

This object represents a concrete product variant/SKU. Relevant metadata includes:

- `name` — variant name
- `default_code` — internal reference
- `barcode` — barcode
- `product_tmpl_id` — related product template
- `product_template_attribute_value_ids` — attribute values defining the variant
- `product_template_variant_value_ids` — variant values defining the combination
- `is_product_variant` — indicates it is a product variant
- `sale_ok` — whether it can be sold

The primary relationship for the variant’s own values is the many-to-many field `product_template_variant_value_ids`, related to `product.template.attribute.value`.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

message.content:
已完成**仅模式/字段定义准备**，未读取任何业务记录，也未创建或修改工作簿。

### 对应业务对象

1. **`product.product` — Product Variant（产品变体）**
   - 表示按具体属性组合区分的可售款式。
   - 可用字段：
     - `name`：变体名称
     - `default_code`：内部参考
     - `barcode`：条码
     - `sale_ok`：是否可销售
     - `active`：是否启用
     - `product_tmpl_id`：所属产品模板
     - `product_template_attribute_value_ids`：该变体的属性值组合

2. **`product.template` — Product（产品模板）**
   - 表示款式/产品的基础定义。
   - 相关字段：
     - `name`
     - `attribute_line_ids`：产品属性行
     - `product_variant_ids`：对应的产品变体
     - `sale_ok`
     - `active`

3. **`product.attribute` — Product Attribute（产品属性）**
   - 表示“颜色”“尺码”等属性类型。
   - 相关字段：
     - `name`
     - `display_type`
     - `value_ids`
     - `attribute_line_ids`

4. **`product.attribute.value` — Attribute Value（属性值）**
   - 表示具体颜色或尺码值。
   - 相关字段：
     - `name`
     - `attribute_id`
     - `active`
     - `html_color`（适用于颜色值）

5. **`product.template.attribute.value` — Product Template Attribute Value**
   - 表示某个产品模板中实际启用的属性值。
   - 相关字段：
     - `product_tmpl_id`
     - `attribute_id`
     - `product_attribute_value_id`
     - `name`
     - `ptav_product_variant_ids`

### 关键关系

```text
product.template
  └─ product.variant_ids → product.product
       └─ product_template_attribute_value_ids
            ├─ attribute_id → product.attribute
            ├─ product_attribute_value_id → product.attribute.value
            └─ product_tmpl_id → product.template
```

因此，若后续需要导出“每一个可售款式，并区分颜色和尺码”，主要数据类型应为：

- 根对象：`product.product`
- 产品基础关系：`product_tmpl_id`
- 变体属性组合：`product_template_attribute_value_ids`
- 属性类型：`product.attribute`
- 属性值：`product.attribute.value`

function.name: office

action.description: Use export_records for a complete Odoo dataset export through the existing Office Candidate lifecycle.

confirmation_reason.description: A concise user-facing description of the unresolved business risk, required only when confirmation_required=true.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Set true only when the user request leaves a material business-risk decision unresolved; include a clear confirmation_reason. Ordinary explicit edits do not need a second confirmation.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: Describe the record type for individual purchasable product variants rather than the shared catalog definition.
