function.description: The existing Office file lifecycle facade, extended with complete Odoo dataset export. action=export_records collects authorized records and returns a Candidate requiring explicit user acceptance.
function.name: office

action.description: Use export_records for a complete Odoo dataset export through the existing Office Candidate lifecycle.

confirmation_reason.description: A concise user-facing description of the unresolved business risk, required only when confirmation_required=true.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Set true only when the user request leaves a material business-risk decision unresolved; include a clear confirmation_reason. Ordinary explicit edits do not need a second confirmation.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: 我需要描述每个项目本身的资料，而不是任务清单；请只查找其数据结构。

**业务对象**
- 技术模型：`project.project`
- 业务名称：Project（项目）

**关键字段定义**

- 描述：`description`（html）

- 截止/到期日期：`date`（date）
- 可见性：`privacy_visibility`（selection）
- 是否启用：`active`（boolean）
- 标签：`tag_ids`（many2many → `project.tags`）
- 分析账户：`account_id`（many2one → `account.analytic.account`）
- 工作时间：`resource_calendar_id`（many2one → `resource.calendar`）
- 创建时间：`create_date`（datetime）
- 最后更新时间：`write_date`（datetime）

**关系定义**
- 任务清单：`task_ids` / `tasks`（one2many → `project.task`，通过 `project_id`）
  - 按你的要求，未将任务作为本次项目资料对象。
- 项目里程碑：`milestone_ids`（one2many → `project.milestone`，通过 `project_id`）
- 项目更新：`update_ids`（one2many → `project.update`，通过 `project_id`）
- 协作者：`collaborator_ids`（one2many → `project.collaborator`，通过 `project_id`）
- 成员：`favorite_user_ids`（many2many → `res.users`）
- 允许用户：`allowed_user_ids`（many2many → `res.users`）
- 标签：`tag_ids`（many2many → `project.tags`）
- 文档：`document_ids`（one2many → `documents.document`）

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: Identify the project-level business object and describe its fields and relations only.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

Search runs through the current user's Odoo ORM permissions.

function.description: The existing Office file lifecycle facade, extended with complete Odoo dataset export. action=export_records collects authorized records and returns a Candidate requiring explicit user acceptance.
function.name: office

action.description: Use export_records for a complete Odoo dataset export through the existing Office Candidate lifecycle.

confirmation_reason.description: A concise user-facing description of the unresolved business risk, required only when confirmation_required=true.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Set true only when the user request leaves a material business-risk decision unresolved; include a clear confirmation_reason. Ordinary explicit edits do not need a second confirmation.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: 请区分仓库调拨的主操作单据和其中逐项货物移动任务，先通过模型定义和字段关系确认，不读取业务记录。

message.content:
已完成**仅 schema 的模型发现与字段关系确认**，未读取任何业务记录，也未创建或修改工作簿。

### 识别结果

#### 1. 仓库调拨主操作单据：`stock.picking`
- 描述：Transfer
- 记录名称字段：`name`（Reference）
- 与逐项货物移动任务的关系：
  - `move_ids` → `stock.move`，一对多，逆向字段：`picking_id`
  - `move_line_ids` → `stock.move.line`，一对多，逆向字段：`picking_id`
- 相关主单据字段包括：
  - `name`：操作单号
  - `state`：操作状态
  - `picking_type_id`：操作类型
  - `location_id`：源位置
  - `location_dest_id`：目标位置
  - `scheduled_date`：计划日期
  - `date_done`：完成日期
  - `transfer_order_id` → `world.depot.transfer.order`：关联业务调拨单

#### 2. 逐项货物移动任务：`stock.move`
- 描述：Stock Move
- 记录名称字段：`name`（Description）
- 与主操作单据的关系：
  - `picking_id` → `stock.picking`，多对一
- 与更细粒度实际操作明细的关系：
  - `move_line_ids` → `stock.move.line`，一对多，逆向字段：`move_id`
- 相关字段包括：
  - `product_id`：产品
  - `product_uom_qty`：需求数量
  - `quantity` / `product_qty`：数量字段
  - `product_uom`：计量单位
  - `location_id`：源位置
  - `location_dest_id`：中间/目标位置
  - `state`：移动状态
  - `picking_id`：所属主操作单据

#### 3. 实际逐项操作明细：`stock.move.line`
- 描述：Product Moves (Stock Move Line)
- 记录名称字段：`product_id`
- 与货物移动任务的关系：
  - `move_id` → `stock.move`，多对一
- 与主操作单据的关系：
  - `picking_id` → `stock.picking`，多对一
- 相关字段包括：
  - `product_id`：产品
  - `qty_done`：已完成数量
  - `quantity`：数量
  - `product_uom_id`：计量单位
  - `location_id` / `location_dest_id`：实际源/目标位置
  - `lot_id` / `lot_name`：批次/序列号
  - `package_id` / `result_package_id`：源/目标包装

### 另发现的业务调拨单模型

系统还注册了定制模型：

- `world.depot.transfer.order`：Transfer Order
  - 主单号：`billno`
  - 明细关系：`line_ids` → `world.depot.transfer.order.line`
  - 关联库存操作：`stock_picking_id` → `stock.picking`

- `world.depot.transfer.order.line`：Transfer Order Line
  - 所属主调拨单：`transfer_order_id`
  - 产品：`product`
  - 数量：`quantity`
  - 源位置：`location_from`
  - 目标位置：`location_to`

### 区分结论

存在两层业务概念：

1. **业务调拨单**：`world.depot.transfer.order`  
   其明细为 `world.depot.transfer.order.line`。

2. **库存执行层的主操作单据**：`stock.picking`  
   其逐项库存移动任务为 `stock.move`；若需要查看批次、序列号、实际完成数量和包装等更细粒度信息，则使用 `stock.move.line`。

message.content:
Schema-only preparation completed. No business records were read, and no workbook was created or modified.

## Business objects

| Business concept | Odoo model | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Shared item definition | `product.template` | Product-level definition shared by its variants |
| Concrete sellable option | `product.product` | Product Variant representing a specific option/configuration |

## Relationship

- `product.template.product_variant_ids`
  - Type: one-to-many
  - Related model: `product.product`
  - Meaning: all concrete variants belonging to the shared product definition
- `product.product.product_tmpl_id`
  - Type: many-to-one
  - Related model: `product.template`
  - Meaning: the shared product definition for that concrete variant

## Relevant schema fields

### `product.template`
- `name` — shared product name
- `product_variant_ids` — related concrete variants
- `product_variant_count` — number of variants
- `attribute_line_ids` — product attributes used to define options

### `product.product`
- `name` — variant name
- `product_tmpl_id` — parent shared product definition
- `default_code` — variant internal reference
- `barcode` — variant barcode
- `product_template_attribute_value_ids` — attribute values defining the variant

No record search was performed.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. 已完成**模式/结构识别**，未查询任何业务记录，也未创建或修改工作簿。

## 业务对象

### 1. 仓库出库业务单

- **技术模型**：`world.depot.outbound.order`
- **对象描述**：Outbound Order
- **显示名称字段**：`billno`（BillNo）

与商品明细的关系：

- **字段**：`outbound_order_product_ids`
- **类型**：一对多（one2many）
- **明细模型**：`world.depot.outbound.order.product`
- **反向字段**：`outbound_order_id`
- **含义**：一张出库业务单包含多条逐项商品明细。

### 2. 出库商品明细

- **技术模型**：`world.depot.outbound.order.product`
- **对象描述**：Outbound Order Product
- **父单关系字段**：`outbound_order_id`
- **类型**：多对一（many2one）
- **关联模型**：`world.depot.outbound.order`

商品关系：

- **字段**：`product_id`
- **类型**：多对一（many2one）
- **关联模型**：`product.product`
- **含义**：明细对应的商品。

## 主要字段关系摘要

| 层级 | 字段 | 类型 | 关联对象/用途 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 出库单 | `outbound_order_product_ids` | one2many | 关联出库商品明细 |
| 商品明细 | `outbound_order_id` | many2one | 返回所属出库业务单 |
| 商品明细 | `product_id` | many2one | 关联商品主数据 |
| 商品明细 | `outbound_order_product_serial_numbers` | one2many | 关联该明细的序列号明细 |
| 出库单 | `outgoing_picking_lines` | one2many | 关联出库拣货单 `stock.picking` |
| 出库单 | `picking_Out` | many2one | 关联出库拣货单 |
| 出库单 | `picking_PICK` | many2one | 关联拣货单 |
| 出库单 | `warehouse` | many2one | 关联仓库 `stock.warehouse` |

## 商品明细中可用于后续导出的典型字段

- `product_id`：商品
- `quantity`：数量
- `default_code`：商品默认编码
- `barcode`：条码
- `product_ean`：商品 EAN
- `source_product_code`：来源商品编码
- `lot_name`：批次名称
- `serial_numbers`：序列号
- `weight`：净重
- `weight_subtotal`：净重小计
- `locations`：库位
- `package_id`：包装
- `pallet_no`：托盘号
- `outbound_order_id`：所属出库单

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: 请导出订单资料。不同业务方向会影响导出范围，先确认我指的是哪一类；确认前不要读取任何业务记录。

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: Export the inventory movement information. The intended scope could change what is included, so ask me to clarify before reading any business records.

function.description: Retrieve records from any Odoo model with filtering capabilities. Specify model, domain, fields, limit, offset, and optional ORM order. Set include_pagination=true to receive records plus the current-user-visible count, offset, limit, and has_more; continue pages until has_more is false when the request asks for all matches. Search runs through the current user's Odoo ORM permissions.
function.name: odoo_record_retriever

anyOf.description: Standard Odoo domain. Use JSON scalar arrays for in/not in values.

operation.description: Omit to use the legacy search contract.

function.description: The existing Office file lifecycle facade, extended with complete Odoo dataset export. action=export_records collects authorized records and returns a Candidate requiring explicit user acceptance.
function.name: office

action.description: Use export_records for a complete Odoo dataset export through the existing Office Candidate lifecycle.

confirmation_reason.description: A concise user-facing description of the unresolved business risk, required only when confirmation_required=true.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Set true only when the user request leaves a material business-risk decision unresolved; include a clear confirmation_reason. Ordinary explicit edits do not need a second confirmation.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: Export the inventory movement information. The intended scope could change what is included, so ask me to clarify before reading any business records.

message.content:
Schema-only preparation completed; no business records were read and no workbook was created or modified.

The phrase “inventory movement information” could refer to several Odoo objects:

- **Stock moves (`stock.move`)** — planned or completed product movements, with product, demand/quantity, source and destination locations, operation type, status, scheduled date, transfer, and related detailed move lines.
- **Detailed move lines (`stock.move.line`)** — operational movement details, including quantity done, product, source/destination locations, lots or serial numbers, packages, dates, and transfer.
- **Transfers (`stock.picking`)** — transfer-level documents containing status, reference, operation type, source/destination locations, dates, partner, and related stock moves or detailed operations.

Which scope should the export use?

1. **Stock moves** — one row per stock move  
2. **Detailed move lines** — one row per operational movement line, including lot/package details  
3. **Transfers** — one row per transfer  
4. **Transfers with related stock moves or detailed move lines**  
5. Another scope, such as only completed movements, a date range, specific warehouses, products, or movement types

您希望整理哪一种“产品”业务信息？

例如：

1. **产品基本资料**：产品名称、内部参考号、条码、产品类型、销售价、成本价、启用状态

3. **产品库存资料**：库存数量、可用数量、仓库/库位  
4. **产品销售资料**：销售订单中的产品、客户、数量、金额、日期  
5. **产品采购资料**：采购订单中的产品、供应商、数量、金额、日期  
6. **产品明细/变体资料**：产品模板、规格属性、具体变体  
7. **其他**：请说明希望整理的业务信息和字段

请告诉我您要哪一种（可多选），以及是否需要包含相关明细或关联信息。

Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. function.description: The existing Office file lifecycle facade, extended with complete Odoo dataset export. action=export_records collects authorized records and returns a Candidate requiring explicit user acceptance.
function.name: office

action.description: Use export_records for a complete Odoo dataset export through the existing Office Candidate lifecycle.

confirmation_reason.description: A concise user-facing description of the unresolved business risk, required only when confirmation_required=true.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Set true only when the user request leaves a material business-risk decision unresolved; include a clear confirmation_reason. Ordinary explicit edits do not need a second confirmation.

messages.content: For a complete Odoo data export when the user gives a business name rather than a technical model, do not guess a model from a familiar Odoo app. First call the existing odoo_record_retriever with operation=discover using the user's natural business wording or a concise paraphrase that preserves its meaning. Discovery ranks registered model metadata semantically; do not translate the request into a guessed technical model name. Review the returned model names and descriptions and, when needed, call operation=describe on plausible candidates to compare their fields and relations. You may use read-only discover/describe to resolve technical uncertainty without asking the user for Odoo model or field names. If the business meaning remains ambiguous after read-only discovery and the alternatives would change the result, ask the user to clarify before searching business records. Select a model only when the user's intent supports it, then use describe to choose query fields and child collections. Only then search records. Creating a new workbook from Odoo data does not require a source workbook or user upload. Set workbook_source=new and do not ask the user to upload a blank file or template. For an Odoo record export, never use Office action=create or action=edit: create directly publishes a source-less V1 and bypasses the required Candidate review. Always use action=export_records, regardless of whether the user requests a new workbook. Supply all schema-required inputs: choose workbook_source=new for a requested new workbook and current only to modify an accepted current workbook; provide source_query (model, domain, fields, order), collections (the discovered relation and child fields), tables (the requested output columns), and a verification_profile appropriate to the requested transformation. The trusted Collector performs complete paging and relation collection. For each requested one-to-many or many-to-many detail collection, add a separate output table whose source is that collection's key and whose columns use discovered child field names. Keep the root table limited to root-model fields; never use dotted relation paths as table source fields. For visible output, include only requested columns or columns needed to render a requested relationship; do not add raw IDs, duplicate fields, or generic display_name columns unless the user explicitly requests them. Prefer the discovered relational field itself for a requested related business entity. Internal identity columns are added by the Collector and must not be exposed as visible business columns. Do not invent fields or relations. Registry metadata is only a schema map: every business read still uses the current user's authorized ORM path.

Use the Route B Office workflow for this Thread. The only file lifecycle Tool is `office`; Odoo data reads use the separate `odoo_record_retriever` Tool under the current user's ORM permissions. Do not use M1 Mapping or row-expansion tools for Route B content production. For a blank XLSX with no Odoo data request, use office(action='create'). For a new workbook exporting Odoo records, use action=export_records with workbook_source=new; no source workbook or upload is required. Do not invent an input file, source SHA, parent version, or Candidate/Accept event; report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and its unverified scope honestly. For an edit, call office(action='edit') once with the current user's natural-language request. Do not submit workbook inspection IDs, Expected Effect coordinates, effect digests, hashes, revision values, or other server-owned fields. The trusted service resolves the private uploaded workbook for the first Candidate and the Accepted Current bytes for later edits. The Responses Adapter and Hosted Code Interpreter perform the edit and return actual XLSX bytes. If a material business-risk choice is not already authorized by the user's request, set confirmation_required=true with a concrete explanation and wait for the authenticated user's confirmation before editing. Do not ask the user for sheet names or coordinates when the workbook and request can establish them. A generated Candidate is not Current until the user reviews and accepts it. Successful `odoo_record_retriever` results from this same user turn are attached by the server to the edit request as authorized data; use those returned record IDs and values without inventing missing data. When a request requires new Odoo data, call the separate `odoo_record_retriever` first; successful results from the same user turn are attached to the edit request. For acceptance or rejection, call office(action='accept' or action='reject') with the candidate_version_id returned by the latest Candidate; the server checks it against this Thread's stored Tool result and the authenticated user's actual message. FAILED or technically blocked Candidates cannot be accepted. VERIFIED and PARTIALLY_VERIFIED grades remain unchanged after acceptance; explain unknowns and do not claim business correctness is proven. Current changes only after the user's explicit Accept. Reject leaves Current unchanged. When the user asks to generate or deliver the final file, call office(action='finalize') on the accepted Current without asking for another Accept. Claim delivery only after the tool reports completed/finalized/delivered and posts the attachment card. Never claim a file edit unless a real Office Tool result contains a Candidate. The Responses Provider dispatch is disabled by default; do not claim success if the service returns blocked.

For an Excel export, first identify the business object and relevant field/relationship definitions. This is schema-only preparation: do not read business records and do not create or modify any workbook. Business request: 只识别并描述客户、供应商和联系人档案对应的数据对象及字段，不读取记录。
